big_picture: Find the smallest next experiment that can materially change the programme's belief about a tradable information mechanism.

historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Mechanism-led curve/spread, event, volatility or other complementary signal roles that clear target-specific feasibility before protected testing.
historical_facts.observed: No robust trading edge is established. The owned Databento archive is manifest-verified across 17 yearly definition, ohlcv-1d and statistics segments from 2010-06-06 through 2026-08-12. #285 used all 5,025 dates and reproduced two external stylized facts: M1/M6/M12 annualized same-contract close-return volatility of 0.4837/0.2937/0.2105 and a +0.1341 winter-minus-injection curve-relative log-price difference.
historical_facts.rules_out: Broad adaptive model search as the default next branch and treating the pre-2015 archive as useless merely because it cannot satisfy the frozen settlement-plus-volume design.

programme_interpretation: #285 provides a positive calibration result for data/market semantics, not a trading edge: the long-history pipeline reproduces two literature-supported Henry Hub structures. Preserve the full archive as consumed development evidence and treat the frozen future-only Samuelson successor design as the first possible independent replication path.
remaining_untested_roles: future-only Samuelson confirmation after 504 new eligible Databento dates accrue
other complementary non-model information roles after programme-value screening
revisit_trigger: For the #285 successor, open only future Databento dates strictly after 2026-08-12 once the frozen 504-date allocation is complete and independently manifested; do not recycle the 5,025 development dates as confirmation.

stopping_rules.confirmation_capacity: hold if no independent confirmation capacity remains
stopping_rules.economic_relevance: stop if the economic MEPI cannot be cleared
stopping_rules.expected_information_value: choose the next slice only when it can materially change a programme decision
stopping_rules.feasible_power: hold until the selected slice has a quantitative feasibility calculation
stopping_rules.negative_evidence: stop or branch when repeated governed evidence rejects the mechanism

tested_role_target_horizon: #279 verified the full Databento archive. #285 then used all 5,025 owned dates to replicate literature-supported Henry Hub maturity-volatility and seasonal curve structure under explicit OHLCV-close semantics, and froze a future-only Samuelson confirmation specification without opening protected outcomes.
useful_secondary_observations: The integrated system still needs complementary signal families whose value survives simple baselines and realistic evidence gates.
why_zoomed_in: Generic one-session return model search has repeatedly failed, while the strongest positive observation remains unconfirmed because effective information was inadequate.
